turns.assistant_text:
Here are the "5 điều Bác Hồ dạy" (5 teachings of Uncle Ho):

1. **Yêu Tổ Quốc, yêu đồng bào** (Love the Fatherland, love the people): This emphasizes the importance of patriotism and caring for fellow citizens.

2. **Học tập, lao động** (Study and work): Encouraging continuous learning and hard work as essential values for personal and national development.

3. **Đoàn kết, tương trợ** (Unity and mutual support): Highlighting the significance of solidarity and helping one another in society.

4. **Khiêm tốn, thật thà, dũng cảm** (Modesty, honesty, and courage): Promoting virtues of humility, integrity, and bravery in facing challenges.

5. **Giữ gìn vệ sinh, bảo vệ môi trường** (Maintain hygiene and protect the environment): Stressing the importance of cleanliness and environmental protection for a better living space.

For more details, you can refer to the following sources:
- [Cánh sóng Niềm tin](https://www.facebook.com/canhsongniemtin9945/posts/nh%E1%BB%AFng-l%E1%BB%9Di-b%C3%A1c-d%E1%BA%A1y-th%E1%BA%ADt-gi%E1%BA%A3n-d%E1%BB%8B-nh%C6%B0ng-v%C3%B4-c%C3%B9ng-cao-qu%C3%BD-l%C3%A0-h%C3%A0nh-trang-cho-c%C3%A1c-th%E1%BA%BF-h/122239190126567292)
- [Trường Mầm Non Hoa Phượng Vỹ](https://mnhoaphuongvy.hcm.edu.vn/loi-bac-day-ngay-nay-nam-xua/5-dieu-bac-ho-day/ctfull/111344/902840)

If you need more information or a specific aspect of these teachings, feel free to ask!
